questions.question: Define definite and indefinite loops. Give one Python example for each. / HH:MM:SS.
questions.solution_html:
• Answer: A definite loop executes a fixed number of times (1 Mark), e.g., a for loop.
  • for i in range(5)
  • print(i) executes exactly five times - (2 Mark)
  • An indefinite loop executes until a condition becomes false -(1 Mark)
  • e.g., a while loop. while x < 5: x += 1 continues until x reaches 5 ((1 Mark))
questions.final_answer: e.g., a while loop. while x ()
